negative_results: No 1963 NORAD 528 plate, radar observation or time-tagged astrometry retrieved from those finding aids.
The Smithsonian main siarchives finding-aid page returned Request Rejected on direct navigation; indexed station-history excerpt available.
SOVA folder pages exposed catalog metadata but no digitized primary records to inspect.
Do not infer absence of all 1963 Brazilian optical/radar stations from the later move of the specific Smithsonian Baker-Nunn camera.
